services.name: Whale Watching Cruise
services.desc: Monterey Bay Canyon is a playground for ocean creatures Duration 2.5- 3 hours About Come observe blue whales, humpback whales, gray whales, killer whales (orcas), dolphins, sea otters, mola molas, seals, sea lions, jellyfish, pelicans, sooty sheerwaters, sea turtles, and much more in their natural environment aboard the nicest and largest boats on Monterey Bay, the Goddess Fantasy. Our on-board Marine Biologists will share their passion to educate and amaze you with facts about these magnificent animals.
